highlights.title: Live Updates: Nepal Roughly Doubles Number of Missing to 1,900 Amid Desperate Search for Survivors
highlights.summary: A spokeswoman for the disaster relief agency said the tally grew after some 900 people were reported missing from hydropower projects. Rescue efforts were complicated by fears of new possible flooding.
